messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — daily billing export shows GPU spend +3.9x yesterday (2026-11-02). Most of the delta is from untagged resources that show up as "unknown project" in the export. Putting sample lines below. :eyes:

Alex Chen: Can you paste the BigQuery export link and a few offending project IDs? I can run a tag and region breakdown.

Maya Patel: Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports?project=redwood-infra (exported table: billing.gcp_export_20261102). Sample project IDs: project-temp-experiments-42, project-redwood-ml-prod-17, project-janitor-349.

Alex Chen: Running quick query to aggregate GPU costs by project/labels:```sql
SELECT project.id AS project_id, COALESCE(labels.cost_center, 'UNLABELED') AS cost_center, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_export_20261102`
WHERE service.description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project_id, cost_center
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Ops-GCP: Ran it — results (top 6):
project-redwood-ml-prod-17, team=ml;env=prod, $12,432.01
project-temp-experiments-42, (no labels), $9,980.33  <-- many idle preemptible GPUs in us-west1-a
project-janitor-349, team=infra;env=staging, $2,140.00
project-unattributed-001, (no labels), $1,920.44
project-data-embed-9, team=data;env=prod, $1,102.10
project-rl-sim-4, (no labels), $980.72

Ops-GCP: Added inventory note: 14 z1-type VMs with attached GPUs running >18h in us-west1-a across the unlabeled projects. Suspect test runs left active. I linked the vm IDs to the export.

Finance Bot: Reminder — untagged GPU costs get routed to the "Unallocated" bucket for monthly chargeback. If we don't attribute by Friday cutoff, cost will be posted against central infra. Impact: >$9k this event.

Samir Gupta: For immediate control: 1) Create a $10k/day budget alert scoped to GPU SKU; 2) Auto-notify owners and escalate to infra on breach; 3) Backfill labels for last 30 days where possible for chargeback. Ops, can you do (3)?

Ops-GCP: We can backfill labels for GCE instances and AI Platform jobs where the resource metadata exists. For ephemeral clusters spun up by internal CI, labels are missing — we'll need owners to opt-in or we'll assign to "team=unassigned" temporarily. Running backfill job now (ETA ~45m).

Alex Chen: Also adding a short-term rule in routing: if project has >5 GPUs and no cost_center label, tag as "cost_center:investigation" and notify channel. That will let Finance see inflight costs before monthly close.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Can Ops drop the list of VM IDs and team contacts when backfill completes? We'll update the billing ticket (#BI-847) and open a request to enforce label check on new GPU allocation.

Ops-GCP: Will post VM IDs + patch summary in #eng-infra when job completes.

Finance Bot: Logged event: BI-847 updated: 'Untagged GPU spike — 2026-11-02'. Threshold rule proposed: daily GPU spend alert at $7,500. Ping: @Samir Gupta for approval. :bell:

Samir Gupta: Approved the $7.5k/day budget alert for GPUs. Also recommend a follow-up to require label enforcement in CI templates.

Alex Chen: Follow-up notes: create alert, run backfill, open PR for CI templates (add required labels step). I'll own the PR.

Maya Patel: Great — will monitor tomorrow's export and confirm whether cost moves to projects or stays in Unallocated. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
